messages.text: Hyung, did you see the fancam from today's dry run?
I did. Why? You were smiling during the chorus transition.
Because you squeezed my fingers right before the beat drop! My heart almost stopped on live broadcast 🙈
You were looking nervous, Anxinie. I told you I'd always be right there next to you.
I know... hearing your voice through my in-ear monitor was the only reason I didn't mess up the high note.
Also... happy 500 days, Sangwon-ah. Thank you for loving me since our trainee days.
Happy 500 days, my Anxinie. You have no idea how much I love you. Wearing our ring under my stage gloves felt so special today.
Hyung look what I just found in my gallery from that day on the couch in the small studio room 🙈
You looked so cute looking up with your messy bangs while we were playing games together 💕
Yah Zhou Anxin... when did you take the second one? My hair was completely wild haha. I love that memory so much though.
Don't stay too late at the studio tonight. You've been practicing non-stop for 8 hours.
Just recording the final harmony guide for our duo track. I'll be home soon.

incomingQueue.text: Hyung, are you almost done at the studio? I left your favorite peach tea in the fridge...
I warmed up the beef ribs Noona sent, and I left your favorite oversized hoodie on your side of the bed 🤍 Don't push yourself too hard tonight, my Sangwon.

messages.text: Sangwon-ah!! Did the courier box arrive at your agency front desk today? 🎁
Yes Noona! The security guard brought it up to our dorm. Thank you so much.
Mom marinated your favorite braised galbi for three days! And I bought the most expensive six-year red ginseng tonic for your throat.
Make SURE you give half of everything to Anxinie! He looked so slender at the airport press conference last week, Noona worries he doesn't eat enough carbs in Korea!
Haha don't worry Noona, he already unpacked the galbi and his eyes lit up. He says thank you and sends his love.
Aww my sweet Anxinie 🥰 Tell him Noona will take both of you out for authentic Chongqing hotpot after your tour finishes!
P.S. I watched the music show fancam... the way you looked at him during the bridge, you silly boy 💕 Be careful around the dispatch reporters! Noona is always cheering for you two.
Notice to ALD1: Tomorrow's Music Bank pre-recording call time moved to 05:30 AM at KBS Hall.
Sangwon, your custom in-ear monitors arrived from the audio technician. They're tuned for your duo stage with Anxin.
Make sure everyone goes to sleep before 1 AM. No ordering late-night spicy tteokbokki!
Guys who put the peach tea on the top shelf of the dorm fridge?
DO NOT TOUCH IT Minho hyung!! Anxin bought that specially for Sangwon hyung lmaooo
Yeah if you drink Sangwon's peach tea, Anxin will chase you with the vacuum cleaner again 💀
I heard that! Hands off the peach tea and Noona's beef ribs, they're for Sangwon hyung after vocal recording 😤
